eligibility.quote:
As it stands, the take_sequence test fulfills the first part of that
(it was initialized by rmw_message_sequence_init()), but doesn't fulfill
the second part (populated by ROS messages).
eligibility.reason: The test passes an insufficiently initialized argument to a separately built rmw library. The precondition violation crosses an API boundary and the issue supplies the resulting abort stack. This supports PAIR and E1-E4 even though the resolving edit is in the caller.

failed_conditions.quote:
Make sure to do the
initialization to a known type before calling rmw_take_sequence.
failed_conditions.reason: The message sequence lacks populated message pointers, violating an API precondition. other and api:rmw_take_sequence accurately describe the failed condition; this is not evidence of mismatched message type declarations.

loudness.reason: The report supplies a runtime abort and stack trace, not an explanatory build/connection/activation diagnostic. No independently reported compatibility refusal precedes the abort.

detection_stage.reason: The stack locates the failure in the executing take_sequence test.

resolution.quote: CI is green, merging.  Thanks for the review.
resolution.reason: The caller fix was accepted and CI passed, but no revision-identified successful rerun of the intermittently failing pair is supplied. The proposed Cyclone-side change was subsequently withdrawn, so it is not an additional observed resolution.

notes: Read the issue, PR 175 discussion/diff, and PR 280 discussion. The later correction in PR 280 explicitly retracts the alleged Cyclone type-confusion problem; it should not be added as a missed condition or treated as a merged provider fix.
